rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
Here, whales and sea lions swim, splashing freely into the 
water.  As you travel across the ocean's surface, you note your 
image below, waving with the waves.  Zephyrs rush past you, 
blasting you with foam and bits of kelp.

rooms.name: On the Ocean
rooms.desc:
You are floating above the churning surface of the sea.  You 
marvel at the schools of tuna that streak through the water as 
though they were birds sailing in the air.  In the distance, you 
can see the foam of broken sea waves.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A marking has been carved into a tree here along with what appears 
to be slash marks from some sort of weapon. It seems as though whoever
lives within these jungles wants to make it clear that visitors are not
welcome. Black craggs spire upwards to the west and south, forming a 
wall that impedes passage.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
You marvel at the intricate designs of nature as you pause for a 
moment to take in the surroundings. Thousands of intertwined roots  
twist about the trunk of a large, willowy tree and small plants have 
pushed their way through a bed of rocks. Your path is blocked by the
dark craggs to the west, though you can walk along its base to the
north and south.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Aside from the irritating bugs and mosquitoes, the pepetual high-
pitched noises, the stifling heat and dreary moisture, this jungle 
is rather pleasant . . . right? The isle's craggs block passage to 
the north and west.
